ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need camera access so you can take your full-length photo and photos of your pieces.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photos so you can choose your full-length and face photos. Your photos are visible only to you.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: To find which friends in your contacts are on Droblet. E-mail addresses are hashed on your phone; your contacts are never uploaded or stored.
